description: Raised 2026-10-16 while building pane compact --then (a_2izzbA9cT) and the queued-compaction note (a_2izzbhXja). The background_agents_working rule reads that screen as working, so a compaction or a ring waits behind it, as it did for 20 minutes on 2026-10-14. But the screen came with herdr's manifests and has never been recorded here: Claude Code 2.1.288, recorded, goes idle at its prompt while a background agent runs and takes rings (docs/observations/claude-code-2.1.288.md, section 6). Record it with tools/detection-capture.py or ./dev --claude-code, note the version, and decide from the recording whether Claude Code is still inside its turn there (keep waiting) or would take a typed line.
title: Record Claude Code's 'Waiting for N background agents to finish' screen, and decide whether a compaction or ring may be typed there
